errors.quote: Define the per-marker protein background floor as max(isotype signal, empty-droplet ambient).
errors.issue: Isotype binding and empty-droplet counts are distinct distributions, not interchangeable calibrated per-cell signal floors. Their simple maximum/subtraction lacks a normalization and measurement model and can remove genuine low signal.

errors.quote: estimate per-transcript dropout as a function of total UMIs using the agreeing lineage markers
errors.issue: Selecting agreeing markers does not establish known latent transcript abundance or absolute false-negative probabilities. Independently calibrated RNA-positive controls and target-specific sensitivity are needed.

errors.quote: Report fraction of disagreement attributable to each block.
errors.issue: Variance explained by correlated technical and state covariates is not a causal biological/technical mixture fraction. Cell size, RNA content and viability may be biology or mediators; predictive partition does not identify their causes.
An initial baseline is not a time-matched vehicle/unstimulated control for the entire activation series. Culture duration, handling and survival can mimic the proposed temporal sequence.

errors.quote: these RNA–protein disagreements define real, post-transcriptionally/temporally regulated cell states
errors.issue: Orthogonal confirmation supports a real discordant measurement, not automatically a discrete functional state or its particular mechanism. Timing/co-variation alone needs discrimination against continuous kinetics, composition and trafficking alternatives.
This can selectively remove true low-RNA states and change the estimand. Report all-cell denominators, sensitivity and capture limits instead of treating filtered concordance as artifact proof.
The planned cross-validation lacks a protected donor-level split before fitting QC, transformations, thresholds and representation; same-data cell-state covariates are not independent endpoints.

No antibody clone/working chemistry, fitted count model, explicit normalization parameters, independent-donor power target or runnable workflow is selected. Concrete PBMC/timepoint choices help but do not make the full experiment operational.

rationale: Useful PBMC time course, knockout controls and paired smFISH/protein validation proposal. Background subtraction, dropout calibration and causal variance attribution remain underidentified; state claims exceed validation. Integrated representation is explicitly postponed, so no historical adaptive-neighborhood hit.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
The supplied assessment contains no raw data; a plan is not actual figure reproduction. Accessions should be sought in primary records, never invented.
